newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yaohan Int'l in HK$600 mln property sale.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Int'l in HK$600 mln property sale.

text.p: Yaohan International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell a commercial property in Kowloon, currently occupied by Yaohan Department Store (H.K.) Ltd, to Essence Right Ltd for HK$600 million.

"The disposal will generate an excess of approximately HK$144,699,000 over the book cost of the property before tax and expenses," the company said in a statement, adding that net proceeds would be used as working capital.
Yaohan International said it had decided to refocus on its core business of retailing, in particular its department store and distribution business in the greater China region.
"The board considers that the disposal is in the best interest of the company in view of the prevailing buoyant property market conditions," it added.
The property, situated at the Sceneway Garden commercial development in Lam Tin, Kowloon, has a total gross floor area of about 106,062 square feet.
Yaohan International's associate company Yaohan Department Store holds a lease to August 31, 2002. Yaohan International said the lease would not be affected by the sale.
Yaohan International shares closed at HK$0.70 on Wednesday.
